project.name: 摇卦算命
project.designRead: mobile app / mystical seekers / cyberpunk-meets-imperial-chinese / medium density / avoid generic purple gradient
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Cyberpunk x Chinese traditional: obsidian dark + electric jade neon + imperial gold accents, Noto Serif SC display + Noto Sans SC body, neon glow UI elements with I Ching trigram motifs

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: electric jade (#00e5a0) for primary interactive elements and neon accents; imperial gold (#d4a853) for traditional Chinese ornamental highlights
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: two thematic hues — brand jade for cyberpunk identity, gold for Chinese cultural identity

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: sharp 4px small radius, 8-12px medium; coins are circular with ornamental borders; trigram lines are crisp rectangular
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: display: Noto Serif SC 700 for headings and I Ching symbols; body: Noto Sans SC 400 for content; mono: JetBrains Mono for system/tech UI labels
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: glass-morphism cards with border-glow, neon-outlined buttons, circular coin elements with 3D flip animation
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: deep obsidian layered surfaces; glass cards with backdrop-blur; neon glow shadows on interactive elements; no flat white cards
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: stylized coin SVGs with Chinese/cyberpunk motifs; decorative circuit-board patterns merging with cloud/wave Chinese patterns
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: mystical-tech: shake-to-reveal animations, coin flip with particle effects, glowing state transitions

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Dark obsidian base with electric jade (#00e5a0) as primary cyberpunk color and imperial gold (#d4a853) as Chinese cultural accent. Serif display font for Chinese classical feel, sans-serif body, mono for tech UI. Glass-morphism cards with neon borders.
